clips.title: The story
paras: Gornek sends a carved tablet to hunters in the Valley of Trials. It bears Jen'shan's mark and calls them to begin training in the wilderness.

Gornek brings novice hunters a carved tablet after they prove themselves against the boars near the Den. The stone bears Jen'shan's mark. She is a skilled troll huntswoman stationed nearby, and the message shows that seasoned hunters have noticed the young recruit's grit. The lesson now moves beyond surviving the local dangers and toward disciplined training in the wild.

Jen'shan teaches that orcs and trolls have a long history within the Horde. Orcs brought renowned traditions of warriors and shamans, while the Darkspear trolls carried ancient skills in stalking, tracking, and survival. Those skills helped the orcs endure life on Azeroth. As Jen'shan trains new hunters, the two peoples continue to share what they know, bound by respect for the hunt.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, friend.
Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the hunter trainer Jen'shan. She would have words with you when you're ready.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Jen'shan see a mighty hunter before her and da spirits approve.

Da path of da hunter is one of our oldest walks of life. Da Horde turned to us when they be just strugglin' to survive on Azeroth, and they ask us to teach them, to show them the secrets of many tings. They were strong already: strong in shaman ways; strong in warrior ways. But the hunter path not be their path... Then.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Now we teach them those things, and they teach us others. We become one race... Almost. We be allies for long time now. So you remember to help them. And Jen'shan remember to help you.
Jen'shan teach you da ways of the hunter--teach you good. You never forget, hunter's be respected greatly by da tribe. You be havin' a large role to play in da future... You never forget that.
When you feel da need, come to Jen'shan. She teach you as much as she can when she feel you ready.
